meta.parties: Mutturaman Chettiar Et Al. v. Kumarappa Chettiar Et Al

rules.statement: The second and third defendants are entitled to concurrence, and share rateably in the proceeds from realizing the security.
rules.supporting_quote: "Held, that the second and third defendants were entitled to concurrence and, in case of deficiency, to share rateably in the proceeds to be obtained when the security was realized."
